# Sync Race Studios

> Business services for local and independent businesses: website design, AI website assistants, logo design and branding, marketing campaigns, an optional blog content engine, Google Business Profile setup and upkeep, Google Ads management, print marketing and creative, and small web apps that make a business more efficient. One partner, every piece connected.

Websites and apps are built, hosted and managed by Sync Race Studios. Websites are server-side rendered, fast and optimized, with schema markup on every page. They are optimized for AI search (schema markup, llms.txt and clearly written pages for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews) and for Google and Bing. Websites start from $1,500 to build, then $25/month for hosting, which includes a built-in content editor so clients can change their own text, photos and lists; bigger changes after launch are billed at $125/hour. Every website includes Google Analytics and listing in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools. Business apps are quoted per project (build plus monthly management). Branding, Google Business Profile, Google Ads, marketing campaign and print work are billed at $125/hour. Optional AI website assistants answer visitor questions, capture leads and send people to book: $500 setup + $49/month as an add-on, or $750 setup + $79/month as a widget for any website. An optional content engine add-on publishes new blog posts on a regular schedule for $50/month, with an estimate before work starts.

Websites and apps are hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript, hosted on Vercel, with Supabase for data and Cloudflare for DNS. No page builders and no tracking without consent.

The logo is a dragon curve: a strip of paper folded in half ten times and opened so every crease is 90°, giving one line of 1,024 steps that never crosses itself. It stands for taking every part of a business and unwinding it into one cohesive line.

## Projects

- Wanderlust Santa Rosa (wanderlustsantarosa.com): Website for a free weekly food truck festival in Old Courthouse Square, Santa Rosa, with a vendor application and market admin. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Supabase, Vercel. Live.
- Stay Santa Rosa (staysantarosa.com): Travel guide to Santa Rosa and Sonoma wine country created by Hotel E and Art House Santa Rosa, with a searchable 79-place directory and direct hotel booking. Live.
- Topophilia Design Studio (topophiliadesign.com): Interior and wardrobe design studio in Santa Rosa serving Sonoma County and the Bay Area. Full logo and brand identity, custom website design, and Google Analytics, Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools setup. Live.
- Surfline 8th Ave. So (surflinejaxbeach.com): Marketing website with an availability calendar for a Jacksonville, Florida vacation rental. Live.
- Visual HTML editor (htmlv.srcs.online): Lets clients change text and images on their own site without touching code.
